§431:15-108  Continuation of delinquency proceedings.  This article applies to proceedings commenced after July 1, 1988. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]

 

Revision Note

 

  "July 1, 1988" substituted for "the effective date of the insurance code" pursuant to §23G-15.
